items.title: Stop worker result parcel from corrupting binary files by reading them as UTF-8
items.body:
## Problem
`worker/src/index.ts:110-115` builds the result parcel with `readFileSync(path.join(jobDir, relPath), 'utf-8')` for every file in the job dir that is not an original asset. A binary file created by the model (image, zip, compiled artifact) is decoded as UTF-8 and later re-encoded with `Buffer.from(content, 'utf-8')` in `packages/protocol/src/pack.ts:65`, which silently corrupts it. The sweep also includes tool state such as `.claude/` or `node_modules` if the model created them. `worker/src/index.test.ts` only covers a text happy path (`a.ts`), a failing run and log flushing.

## Proposed change
Read result files as Buffers and pass them through `PackedFile` without a lossy text round trip (or skip/flag files that are not valid UTF-8), and exclude well-known tool directories (`.claude/`, `node_modules/`) from the result set. Add tests for a binary file and for an excluded directory.

## Acceptance criteria
- A binary file written by the model survives the result parcel byte-for-byte.
- `.claude/` and `node_modules/` contents are not included in the result parcel.
- New tests in `worker/src/index.test.ts` cover both cases; `npm test` in `worker` passes.

items.title: Test extractArchive's missing-manifest error path with a real zip instead of non-zip input
items.body:
## Problem
`packages/protocol/src/pack.test.ts:34-36` ('throws when the manifest entry is missing') passes `Buffer.from('not a zip')` and asserts only `assert.throws(...)` with no matcher. AdmZip throws on the invalid input, so `extractArchive` never reaches its own `Archive is missing ... not a recognized parcel` error (`pack.ts:103-105`). That branch is effectively untested and any exception would satisfy the test.

## Proposed change
Build a valid zip that contains files but no manifest entry (via AdmZip in the test) and assert the thrown error matches `/missing/`. Keep a separate test for non-zip input if desired.

## Acceptance criteria
- The test constructs a valid zip without the manifest entry and asserts on the error message.
- Removing the missing-manifest check in `pack.ts` makes the test fail.
- `npm test` in `packages/protocol` passes.

items.title: Add tests for walkProject and document that dotfiles are skipped
items.body:
## Problem
`packages/protocol/src/walk.ts:4-10` calls fast-glob with `dot: false, onlyFiles: true, followSymbolicLinks: false`. Files such as `.env.example`, `.gitlab-ci.yml` and `.eslintrc` are therefore never included in a project parcel, and symlinks are skipped, but this is neither documented nor tested. `dictionary`, `pack` and `manifest` all have test files; `walk` has none.

## Proposed change
Add `packages/protocol/src/walk.test.ts` using a temp directory covering include patterns, exclude patterns, dotfile behaviour and symlinks being skipped. Add a short comment in `walk.ts` (and a line in `sync/README.md` if it describes project push) stating that dotfiles are excluded.

## Acceptance criteria
- `walk.test.ts` exists and covers include, exclude, dotfiles and symlinks.
- The dotfile behaviour is documented in a code comment.
- `npm test` in `packages/protocol` passes.

items.title: Test dictionary substitution on Cyrillic text and regex-metacharacter keys
items.body:
## Problem
`packages/protocol/src/dictionary.ts:16-19` explains that `\b` is replaced by `\p{L}\p{N}` lookarounds because `\b` fails on Cyrillic, but `packages/protocol/src/dictionary.test.ts:6-38` uses only ASCII, so a regression to `\b` would pass. Also untested: a dictionary whose only key is the empty string (the `terms.length === 0` branch, `dictionary.ts:30`) and keys containing regex metacharacters such as `a.b`.

## Proposed change
Add tests for: Cyrillic word-boundary replacement in both directions (no replacement inside a longer Cyrillic word), an empty-key-only dictionary being a no-op, and metacharacter keys matched literally.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests cover Cyrillic boundaries, empty-key-only dictionaries, and metacharacter keys.
- Reverting the lookarounds to `\b` makes the Cyrillic test fail.
- `npm test` in `packages/protocol` passes.

items.title: Unlink orphaned uploads on failed DB writes and cover StorageService findOwned/delete in tests
items.body:
## Problem
`bridge/apps/backend/src/storage/storage.service.ts:26` returns `this.storedFileRepository.save({...})` after Multer has already written the file to `UPLOAD_DIR`; if `save` throws, the file stays on disk forever. In `delete` (`storage.service.ts:71-79`) the DB row is removed first and a failed `unlink` is only logged, leaving a permanent orphan. `storage.service.spec.ts:36-110` only has `describe('create')` and `describe('findAllByUser')`; `findOwned` (NotFoundException and userId scoping, the single-recipient isolation guarantee), `path` and `delete` have no tests.

## Proposed change
In `create`, catch a failed `save`, best-effort unlink the uploaded file and rethrow. Add spec cases for `findOwned` (found, not found, other user's file), `delete` (success, unlink failure is logged and does not throw) and the create-failure cleanup.

## Acceptance criteria
- A failing `save` results in the uploaded file being unlinked and the original error rethrown.
- Specs cover `findOwned` ownership scoping and `delete` including the unlink-failure branch.
- `npm test -w backend` passes.
